segment: VALIDATE (2025-10-01 .. 2026-03-31), first look at this rule
selected_from: T83 cell 'Q | reenter 1sd | recent TEMAxEMA cross | hold 1s', chosen from the W/Q cells only (M was in-sample to T82) before any validate data was read

rule.bars: Yahoo =F 1h, roll-cleaned (intraday.flag_1h), indicators in clean-index space
rule.vwap_anchor: quarterly, reset at the first session of each calendar quarter; first 5 sessions unscored
rule.bands: volume-weighted sd of typical price around the anchored VWAP
rule.entry_buy: close crosses back above VWAP - 1 sd (z[t-1] <= -1, z[t] > -1) AND TEMA(9) crossed above EMA(50) within the last 6 bars
rule.entry_sell: close crosses back below VWAP + 1 sd (z[t-1] >= 1, z[t] < 1) AND TEMA(9) crossed below EMA(50) within the last 6 bars
rule.exit: fixed: close of the 23rd bar after entry (one Globex session); no stop, no target
rule.positions: one per market, signals while open ignored, no pyramiding
rule.sizing: one-session 1-sigma move = 0.25% of capital, trailing hourly vol (EWMA span 460) at entry

success_criterion: CONFIRMED only if, at reference costs, portfolio Sharpe > 0 AND mean net per trade > 0 AND random-timing null p < 0.05 (200 draws, session permutation within month shared across markets). Anything else: NOT CONFIRMED.
